author: mmarriot
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds a truth-graph associator (`truthBranchGsfTrackAssociators`) and validator (`truthBranchGsfTrackValidator`) for `electronGsfTracks`.

- Matching: `reco::GsfTrack` is a `reco::Track`, so the existing shared-hit track matching and track thresholds are reused. This is consistent with `trackValidatorGsfTracks` in `Validation/RecoTrack`, which associates `electronGsfTracks` with `quickTrackAssociatorByHits`, as for `generalTracks`. The reco purity cut (0.75) is the same as `Cut_RecoToSim` there.
- Efficiency: the truth denominators are shared by all species, unlike `trackValidatorGsfTracks`, which uses `trackingParticlesElectron`. The efficiency is therefore not an electron efficiency; the fake rate and purity are the relevant quantities.
- HLT GSF tracks (`hltEgammaGsfTracks*`) are not associated yet.

This is a step towards truth-graph associators for all reconstructed collections. Comments from the GSF tracking experts are welcome.

FYI: @cms-sw/egamma-pog-l2 @cms-sw/tracking-pog-l2

#### PR validation:

Code compiles, `code-checks` and `code-format` are clean, and the `PhysicsTools/TruthInfo` and `Validation/TruthInfo` unit tests pass.
